blocks.text: Match preview: Tamil Nadu face Uttarakhand in Elite Group D (TEST) on Sun, 18 Oct, 2026, 9:30 am at MA Chidambaram Stadium Chennai. Full pitch report, weather forecast, and squad details below.
Traditional spin-friendly track; low-scoring Tests, balanced in limited overs.
Thunderstorm · High 29°C / Low 25°C · Rain: 18.4 mm · Wind: up to 9 km/h. Rain likely — DLS may apply; favour bowlers who hit the deck and teams with depth.
International playing XI is announced at the toss. Check back on match day for confirmed line-ups.
